name: le-fabrique
description: Fábrica de software com controle e execução em uma VPS

scripts.build: npm run build -w @le-fabrique/contracts && npm run build -w @le-fabrique/runtime && npm run build -w @le-fabrique/api && npm run build -w @le-fabrique/worker && npm run build -w @le-fabrique/web
scripts.test: node --test scripts/dev.test.mjs && npm run test -w @le-fabrique/contracts && npm run test -w @le-fabrique/runtime && npm run test -w @le-fabrique/api && npm run test -w @le-fabrique/worker && npm run test -w @le-fabrique/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @le-fabrique/contracts && npm run build -w @le-fabrique/runtime && npm run typecheck -w @le-fabrique/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @le-fabrique/runtime && npm run typecheck -w @le-fabrique/api && npm run typecheck -w @le-fabrique/worker && npm run typecheck -w @le-fabrique/web
